method: 24 paired seeded matches: four real-roster seeds for each 73-rated balanced, 80-rated balanced, and elite-possession squad at 180 and 300 seconds. Receipt groups use receiver pressure; passing groups use source pressure. Statistics emerge from simulation.

holdComparison.method: Last12 matched fixtures only; previous12 baseline did not record hold. Hold=engine carrier possession timer at pass release; all passes, including restarts.

nearCollection.method: Lost passes with no teammate collection attempt, classified by minimum ground trajectory distance from intended receiver center.

definitions.shortToFeet: Ordinary ground pass no longer than 24m, aimed within 3m of receiver at release. Through and aerial categories take precedence.
definitions.lowPressure: Observer pressure below 0.45. Passing groups use pressure at release; reception groups use pressure when touched.
definitions.receptionMiscontrol: Failed teammate first touch, including bobbles eventually recovered. Not equivalent to a turnover.
definitions.nearCollection: Observation distance from the intended receiver center, not the engine collection radius. Near passes may still be out of physical reach.
definitions.accuracy: Total credited completions divided by total attempts; not the mean of individual team percentages.
definitions.rates: Descriptive 24-match sample, not game quotas or confidence bounds. Outcomes depend on skills, tactics, pressure and actual geometry.
